mostWorthwhile.text: Punching the card into a star disc was the most worthwhile step: it made the projector's intended effect clearer.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the lamp and battery was clear but felt like routine assembly in the text-only presentation.

surprise.text: The box became a projector as soon as the reflector was fitted, revealing its purpose earlier than I expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; each followed a clear construction goal.

continue.text: I would be mildly curious to continue and see what is built next, though these straightforward fittings offered little decision-making.
